# Glossary

## Terraform terms

| Term | Meaning in this provider |
| --- | --- |
| Provider | The plugin implementing the `onpager/onpager` API integration. |
| Resource | A managed API identity or explicit configuration slot with create, read, update and destroy behavior. Some updates require replacement. |
| Data source | A read-only lookup of an existing API object. It does not manage the object's lifecycle. |
| Argument | A configurable schema attribute. Required/optional arguments and defaults appear in the generated schema. |
| Read-only attribute | A computed value returned by the provider, such as an API UUID or revision. |
| Root configuration | Terraform files loaded from one working directory. Examples are executable root configurations. |
| Module | A reusable Terraform configuration called by a `module` block. Provider resources are not modules. |
| State | Terraform's persisted resource identities, configured/computed values and provider-private data. Sensitive values can still be stored in state. |
| Import | Association of an existing API identity with a resource address. Import reads configuration; a subsequent apply reconciles it. |
| Replacement | Destroy and create when an immutable identity field changes or replacement is requested explicitly. |

## OnPager terms

| Term | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Control API | The authenticated configuration API addressed by provider `endpoint`. Requests use `/v1` paths. |
| Ingress | The event-admission API used by source systems. Its URL and integration token are distinct from provider credentials. |
| Tenant | The API authorization boundary for shared configuration and unique identities. The credential's tenant context applies to provider requests. |
| Team | A configuration and permission scope owning services and team-scoped settings. |
| Service | An alert-routing target with an owning team. Its UUID remains the identity across ownership transfers. |
| Integration | Source-event admission configuration and its source credentials. |
| Delivery channel | A provider/messenger transport registered in OnPager. Its UUID is distinct from a catalog binding UUID. |
| Delivery provider | Transport identifier used by a notification-template slot, such as `telegram` or `zvonok`. |
| Bot | Managed messenger connection, configuration and credential set. Its UUID is also its owned delivery-channel UUID. |
| Voice provider | Managed voice connection and campaigns, currently Zvonok. Its UUID is also its owned delivery-channel UUID. |
| Outgoing webhook | Shared HTTP request definition with named secrets and, for notification use, recipient fields. It does not enroll a user's personal contact. |
| Delivery target | A destination associated with a delivery channel. Channel/target UUIDs must be known when configuring bindings. |
| Catalog binding | One explicit association between an owner and a delivery channel/target. A binding resource does not own the entire catalog. |
| Escalation chain | Ordered escalation steps and their delegation/calendar configuration. |
| Escalation rule | A published condition and its chain-selection configuration. |
| Schedule | On-call settings and references. Primary rotations and overrides are independent child resources. |
| Primary rotation | A stable declaration of participants, recurrence and coverage; `effective_from` is separate from its recurrence anchor. |
| Schedule override | A one-off replacement interval and participant. |
| Work calendar | Recurring work intervals and production-calendar inheritance settings. |
| Calendar entry | One independently managed exception to the work calendar. |
| Handover | Schedule-change notification settings, managed separately from schedule/rotation declarations. |
| Notification-template override | Explicit template source for a type, delivery provider and language, optionally scoped to a team. Inheritance stays within the selected language. |
| Service account | A non-human API identity requiring explicit role assignments and separately issued bearer credentials. |
| Role assignment | An explicit role/recipient/target-scope binding. Ownership of an account does not grant that binding. |
| Team role defaults | The tenant's complete dynamic member and additional lead role sets, applied across existing and future teams. |
| Permission catalog | Native action metadata describing scope, actors and grantability. Reading it grants no action or effective access. |
| Silence | A finite suppression interval with a predicate and tenant or complete multiteam scope. |
| Inhibition rule | Source/target predicates and matcher pairs controlling dependent suppression and captured release/keep behavior. |
| Enrichment dataset | Versioned string-map rows and dataset metadata. |
| Enrichment rules | The complete ordered tenant rule snapshot referencing datasets. |
| Revision / ETag | Resource-specific optimistic concurrency metadata. Numeric, slot-hash and body-version contracts are not interchangeable. |
| Request timezone | The zone sent through `Onpager-Timezone`. The API interprets local datetime input; storage and recurrence semantics remain UTC. |

Use the schema's exact argument names in configuration. Reference pages define
each resource's scope, import identity, update constraints and destroy operation.
